semiconductor_relevance: High — LINTON Technologies Group, through its KAYEX brand, is a leading supplier of single crystal furnaces essential for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: LINTON Technologies Group specializes in the design and manufacture of electronic-grade and photovoltaic-grade silicon and germanium Czochralski single crystal furnaces. With over 60 years of experience, the company is a key player in the semiconductor equipment sector, providing high-quality furnaces that support the growth of single crystal silicon rods.
capabilities: Production of 6-inch to 24-inch single crystal silicon rods
High-volume production of photovoltaic and electronic-grade single crystal furnaces

regional_presence.United States: The company is headquartered in Rochester, New York, where it designs and develops its furnace models.
regional_presence.China: KAYEX has a manufacturing facility in China capable of producing a high volume of single crystal furnaces to meet market demand.
